title: Ultimate Roasted Turkish Eggplant Imam Bayildi
description: A traditional Turkish dish featuring roasted eggplant filled with a creamy mixture, served with double rise bread, this recipe is a solo dinner delight.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the eggplant in half lengthwise and scoop out the flesh, leaving a shell about 1/4 inch thick.
Chop the scooped out eggplant flesh and saute it in olive oil until it is tender.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the creme patissiere, salt, and black pepper, and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stuff each eggplant shell with the eggplant and creme patissiere mixture and place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the tops with olive oil and bake for 30 minutes, or until the eggplant is tender and lightly browned.
Slice the double rise bread into 1 inch thick slices and toast until crispy.
Serve the roasted eggplant with toasted bread and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
